name: Noise floor smoke test 15 min
description: Ticket 0035 SMOKE TEST - 15 minutes, not a data run. Verifies the whole chain end to end before committing 2 hours: scope capture with the coupling off, decoupled motor-on at three speeds, the motor-off baseline, OE mic capture into /oe_samples (3 cycles at 5 min), telemetry, and a clean heater-guard exit. 2 min motor off, then 600/1800/3000 rpm for 2 min each, then 7 min motor off. SV held at 40 C. Same acquisition and scope_channels as the real 0035 profile, so what passes here is what runs there. The three speeds exist so UL/AE energy can be checked to rise with commanded Hz - the only available proof that the decoupled motor actually turned, since the tach's mark is on the rig side and rpm_meas reads 0. SP/CHAN3 volt_offset is 5.0 because the slip ring sits on its ~5 V excitation pedestal; measured 2026-08-29 the channel spans 1.8-8.4 V. The old 8.0/0.0 window (-4 to +4 V) clipped more than half of it. Runs before 2026-08-29 were taken with the scope probe's GROUND LEAD DETACHED, which removed the DC reference and is why SP looked like it sat at 0 V and carried no rotation signal - see ticket 0038.
